services.name: Glass Blowing Experience
services.desc: Join us for our Glass Blowing Experience on Saturday October 3, 2026 from 6-8pm. This workshop will focus on the basics of glass blowing in order to create three unique blown glass ornaments or watering globes. This workshop is designed for beginners and to be a fun and informative experience! Please note all guests must be registered to attend this event. Registration will close at 8pm on October 1, 2026 or when all seats have sold. Each guest will be provided with the materials to create three glass ornaments/globes.
